Class RefreshMechanismHTTP

java.lang.Object
ai.gradientlabs.client.model.RefreshMechanismHTTP
public class RefreshMechanismHTTP extends Object
Defines how to automatically refresh a secret's value using an HTTP request. This is commonly used for OAuth access tokens that need periodic renewal.
